oncall-bot: Pager: billing-metering-heartbeat anomaly detected in eu-west-1. token_count_delta=+16% over 10m. runbook: #metering-pager :rotating_light:
ash (SRE): seeing a shadow-count spike, looks tied to consumer lag on ingest-queue-3
mia (billing): any customers showing overage flags right now?
ash (SRE): not confirmed customer-visible yet. realtime reports delayed ~8m, shadow ledger growth visible
raj (eng): checked kafka: consumer group 'collector-ingest' lag ~120k, collector-3 showing frequent GC pauses and connection retries
nate (billing-eng): replay risk note: if we blindly replay, duplicates could inflate billed tokens. need dedupe-safe replay or watermark+idempotency
olivia (support): two customers opened support threads about alerts. I'm holding public comms until we know scope
ash (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) scale consumers x2 (in progress), 2) pause non-critical backfills, 3) enable emitter dedupe toggle (emit.dedupe=true) behind config flag
raj (eng): rolling hotfix to collector-3: bump JVM heap, flip client backoff to linear from exponential. applying now. cmd: kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/collector-3
mia (billing): if reports stay delayed >30m we should trigger PSAT and prepare billing-safe offsets (runbook section 2.3)
ash (SRE): current ETA for consumer catch-up ~6-9m after scale. will monitor token delta and ledger convergence
oncall-bot: incident update: severity=sev2, pages=3, summary=\"consumer lag causing delayed usage emits\"
nate (billing-eng): prep step: once lag is <1k, run aggregate recompute for last 2h with dedupe filter: recompute --window=2h --dedupe=true
olivia (support): drafting holding note: \"We're investigating delays in usage reports; no confirmed overcharges. We'll update in 20 minutes.\" please flag if wording should change
ash (SRE): handing off to night oncall @mia — leaving pinned offsets, logs, and runbook. offsets: topic=usage-ingest partition=7 offset=1284420
mia (billing): acknowledged — I'll monitor offsets, consumer lag, and coordinate with ops/support. please attach collector logs and the dedupe toggle status
ash (SRE): attaching quick logs excerpt below for handoff:\n```\n[2026-03-20T22:59:12Z] collector-3 WARN reconnecting to kafka after socket timeout\n[2026-03-20T22:59:26Z] consumer lag snapshot: partition=7 lag=120432\n[2026-03-20T23:01:03Z] emitter: wrote shadow ledger row id=... dedupe=false\n```\nash (SRE): TL;DR action items: (1) monitor scaled consumers (2) confirm dedupe toggle enabled and tested (3) hold external billing notices until recompute verified
mia (billing): will take over. will notify support to send holding note and update customers if lag persists
oncall-bot: Incident moved to monitoring at 2991118100. reopen page if token delta >10% again or if lag doesn't drop within 20m.
